Home solar panels in Tel Aviv

By Dana Levi, certified PV engineer. Last updated 1 October 2026.

Acme Solar has installed more than 1,200 residential systems since 2014. Our customers typically cut their electricity bill by 70% and recover the cost in about 6 years, according to the Israeli Ministry of Energy tariff data and IEA solar research.

What does a home solar system cost?

A typical 10 kW rooftop system costs between 25,000 and 45,000 ILS installed, depending on roof type, panel brand and inverter. Prices include permits, grid connection and a 25 years panel warranty. Financing is available with no upfront payment for qualifying homeowners.

  • 5 kW system: 25,000 ILS
  • 10 kW system: 38,000 ILS
  • 15 kW system: 45,000 ILS

How long does installation take?

Installation takes one or two days on site. The whole process, from survey to grid connection, usually takes four to eight weeks because the electric company must approve the connection. We handle all of the paperwork with the authorities for you.

Why choose Acme Solar?

We use tier-one panels, monitor every system remotely and respond to service calls within 48 hours. Every installation is inspected by a licensed electrician before it is switched on. Our team of 35 engineers and installers works across Tel Aviv, Ramat Gan, Herzliya and the wider Gush Dan area, and we have a 4.9 star average from customers.
